name: Sammy Tippett
source:
[i]"Yeah I like stew... What about it?"[/i]

[i]The Dreaming Chef[/i]

A young boy that lives in an orphanage after his parents' death. Though timid and very wary, he admires and adores Lucien due to latter's kind treatment of him.

He dreams of being a chef.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/fd/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
